note: 每日马股速报。每天由排程任务根据公开新闻整理，摘要为 12Invest 自行撰写，每条附来源。

days.title: 马股上周五收1,616.58点；美股科技股反弹，Zetrix AI 遭大马交易所令11月23日前派息

market.note: 上周五美股 AI 科技股重挫拖累区域市场，马股全天受压，跌股远多于涨股，马银行、大众银行和国能等权值股走低。周一为屠妖节假期休市，今天是假后首个交易日。

items.title: 美股周一强劲反弹，油价因美伊和谈希望下滑
items.text: 上周 AI 股抛售后逢低买盘回流，纳斯达克100指数周一收涨3.40%，罗素2000涨3.19%，其他主要指数涨逾2%；辉达则因董事会内部调查而走低。特朗普淡化再度空袭伊朗的可能，布兰特原油早盘跌3.63%至每桶94.75美元。

items.title: 大马交易所令 Zetrix AI 于11月23日前派发拖欠股息
items.text: 大马交易所11月6日致函 Zetrix AI，指示其立即并最迟于11月23日派发2025财年每股2.89仙的终期股息，该股息自9月以来多次延后。MARC 已把其 RM2 billion 伊斯兰债券计划评级降至违约级 D-IS，因公司未能偿还一笔 RM25 million 到期债券。

items.title: SKA Capital 明天上 ACE，KEB、MyDCD 下周挂牌
items.text: SKA Capital（每股43仙）公众部分获80.42倍超额认购，将于11月11日在 ACE Market 挂牌；KEB 和 MyDCD 则分别于11月16日和17日上市。

items.title: 本周业绩：贺特佳周四开跑，MR DIY、Carlsberg 周五登场
items.text: 贺特佳（Hartalega）周四公布2027财年第二季业绩，赚幅受压下表现或较弱；喜力（Heineken Malaysia）与 F&N 同日放榜，MR DIY 和 Carlsberg 则在周五公布业绩。

items.title: West River 转攻高赚幅工程，订单约 RM200m
items.text: 机电工程商 West River 手头订单约 RM195 million 至 RM200 million，正竞标国能太阳能电站变电站与并网工程，并锁定数据中心和半导体厂工程。董事经理预计2026财年按年增长至少30%、2027财年增长30%至50%，未来至少一年不派息。

items.title: 马六甲州选今起提前投票，国内工业生产与棕油数据今天出炉
items.text: 马六甲州选今天展开提前投票，11月14日投票日共79名候选人角逐28个议席。统计局今天公布9月工业生产指数，大马棕油局也发布10月棕油供需数据。

items.title: 分析员：马股本周料在1,600至1,630点间波动
items.text: 乐天证券（Rakuten Trade）预计富时大马综合指数本周在1,600至1,630点之间徘徊，低位料有选择性买盘支撑；市场关注美国10月消费者与生产者物价指数。上周马股仅微升0.98点，全周成交额增至 RM14.43 billion。

en.title: KLCI closed Friday at 1,616.58; US tech rebounds as Bursa orders Zetrix AI to pay overdue dividend by Nov 23
en.note: A Wall Street AI tech rout weighed on regional markets last Friday, and Bursa stayed under pressure all day with decliners far outnumbering gainers as Maybank, Public Bank and Tenaga fell. Monday was a Deepavali market holiday, so today is the first trading day after the break.

items.title: Wall Street rebounds strongly on Monday as oil slips on US-Iran deal hopes
items.text: Dip buyers returned after last week's AI sell-off: the Nasdaq-100 closed 3.40% higher and the Russell 2000 3.19%, with other major indexes up more than 2%, while Nvidia fell amid an internal board investigation. Trump played down the chance of fresh strikes on Iran, and Brent fell 3.63% to US$94.75 a barrel in early trade.

items.title: Bursa orders Zetrix AI to pay overdue dividend by Nov 23
items.text: In a Nov 6 letter, Bursa Malaysia directed Zetrix AI to pay its FY2025 final dividend of 2.89 sen a share immediately and no later than Nov 23, after repeated delays since September. MARC has cut its RM2 billion sukuk programme to D-IS (default) after the company failed to repay a RM25 million maturing bond.

items.title: SKA Capital debuts on ACE tomorrow; KEB and MyDCD list next week
items.text: SKA Capital (43 sen a share), whose public portion was 80.42 times oversubscribed, lists on the ACE Market on Nov 11, followed by KEB on Nov 16 and MyDCD on Nov 17.

items.title: Results week: Hartalega on Thursday, MR DIY and Carlsberg on Friday
items.text: Hartalega reports its 2QFY2027 results on Thursday, which may be weaker on margin compression; Heineken Malaysia and F&N report the same day, and MR DIY and Carlsberg on Friday.

items.title: West River shifts to higher-margin jobs with an order book of about RM200m
items.text: M&E engineering firm West River has an order book of RM195 million to RM200 million and is bidding for TNB solar-farm substation and grid-connection work while targeting data centre and semiconductor plant jobs. Its MD expects growth of at least 30% in FY26 and 30% to 50% in FY27, with no dividends for at least another year.

items.title: Melaka early voting starts today; industrial production and palm oil data due
items.text: Early voting for the Melaka state election begins today, with 79 candidates contesting 28 seats on polling day, Nov 14. DOSM releases September industrial production today and MPOB publishes October palm oil supply and demand data.

items.title: Analyst sees KLCI trading between 1,600 and 1,630 this week
items.text: Rakuten Trade expects the index to hover between 1,600 and 1,630, with selective buying cushioning dips, as markets watch US October consumer and producer price data. The KLCI edged up only 0.98 points last week while weekly turnover rose to RM14.43 billion.

days.title: 马股本周微升0.98点收1,616.58点；国行维持利率，KEB、MyDCD 新股认购出炉

market.note: 周二银行股撑盘，周四国行维持利率后指数大涨19.30点至1,635.86点，但周五华尔街 AI 科技股急挫，马股随区域市场跌1.17%，几乎回吐全部涨幅。全周大马指数仅比上周五的1,615.60点微升，外围不确定因素仍主导市场情绪。

items.title: 本周新股：KEB 认购1.01倍、MyDCD 获36.46倍超额认购，IOIPG REIT 等多只新股开卖
items.text: KEB（每股35仙）公众部分认购1.01倍，11月16日上 ACE；MyDCD（56仙）公众部分超额认购36.46倍，11月17日挂牌。IOIPG Malaysia REIT 以每单位96仙开卖，Yes Group（18仙）与 Emits（16仙）也先后推出招股书；Big Caring 与 Impact Capital 申购分别于11月5日和6日截止，本周无新股挂牌，SKA Capital 将于11月11日上市。

items.title: 国行维持隔夜政策利率于2.75%
items.text: 国家银行周四在今年最后一次货币政策会议上按兵不动，指第三季经济增长稳健、2027年料保持韧性，但能源成本上涨推高通胀。华侨银行预计国行或在2027年1月21日会议升息25个基点至3%。

items.title: 华尔街 AI 股重挫，马股周五急跌1.17%
items.text: 美股周四录得18个月来最差表现，纳指挫5.5%、费城半导体指数跌逾12%，拖累区域股市。马股周五跌19.28点至1,616.58点，几乎抹去周四涨幅；科技股一度跌5.78%，UWC、Vitrox、Pentamaster 与 Inari 跌幅居前。

items.title: SunCon 获 RM920.8m 柔佛数据中心机电工程
items.text: 双威建筑（SunCon）再获柔佛一座数据中心的额外机械、电气与管道（MEP）工程，合约值 RM920.8 million，预计2028年首季完工。

items.title: GDB 获 RM877m 莎阿南物流中心工程，订单增至 RM2.93b
items.text: GDB Holdings 获颁莎阿南15区物流中心工程，需拆除旧厂并兴建两栋五层楼建筑，目标2029年9月完工。连同早前 RM1.02 billion 的 ParkCity 合约，手头订单增至 RM2.93 billion。

items.title: 国能联手 IOI Corp 在马口发展500MW太阳能
items.text: 国能旗下 TNB Renewables（70%）、IOI Corp 子公司（25%）与12家中小企财团（5%）合作，在森美兰马口发展500MW太阳能项目，配备250MW/1,000MWh电池储能，三方股本投入最高合共 RM606.2 million。

items.title: IOIPG 拟设新加坡私募房地产基金，售50%股权或套现近 RM10b
items.text: IOI Properties 计划以价值60亿新元（约 RM19.1 billion）的新加坡资产成立私募房地产基金，出售50%股权可筹近 RM10 billion，并目标在2027年初于新加坡交易所第二上市，同时把净负债率从约85%降至30%至50%。

items.title: Paramount 携手三井不动产发展 RM1.34b 服务式公寓
items.text: 百乐镇（Paramount Corp）与日本三井不动产以51:49合资开发 The Ashbourne 服务式公寓项目，总发展值 RM1.34 billion、共458个单位，预计今年第四季动工、2030年底完工。

items.title: Sapura Industrial 获奇瑞约 RM307m 车轴订单；Binastra 揽 RM303.8m 自动化仓库工程
items.text: Sapura Industrial 与奇瑞汽车签下为期4年半、约 RM307 million 的车轴组装合约，为首次直接与该车厂合作。Binastra 则获 PTT Synergy 颁发 RM303.8 million 自动化仓库工程，工期由11月11日至2027年9月30日。

items.title: 大众银行设立 RM20b 伊斯兰中期票据计划
items.text: 大众银行设立规模 RM20 billion、为期30年的伊斯兰中期票据计划，大马评级机构（RAM）给予高级票据 AAA、次级票据 AA1 的初步评级。

en.title: KLCI edges up 0.98 points this week to 1,616.58; Bank Negara holds rates as KEB and MyDCD IPO results come in
en.note: Banks supported the index on Tuesday, and it jumped 19.30 points to 1,635.86 on Thursday after Bank Negara held rates, but a Wall Street AI tech rout on Friday sent Bursa down 1.17% with regional markets, erasing almost all of the gain. The KLCI ended the week barely above the previous Friday's 1,615.60, with external uncertainty still driving sentiment.

items.title: IPO round-up: KEB 1.01 times subscribed, MyDCD 36.46 times oversubscribed; IOIPG REIT among new offers
items.text: KEB's public portion (35 sen a share) was 1.01 times subscribed ahead of its 16 November ACE Market listing, while MyDCD's (56 sen) was oversubscribed 36.46 times, with listing on 17 November. IOIPG Malaysia REIT opened its offer at 96 sen a unit, and Yes Group (18 sen) and Emits (16 sen) launched their prospectuses; applications for Big Caring and Impact Capital closed on 5 and 6 November. There were no debuts this week; SKA Capital lists on 11 November.

items.title: Bank Negara holds the OPR at 2.75%
items.text: At its final policy meeting of 2026 on Thursday, Bank Negara left the overnight policy rate unchanged, citing solid third-quarter growth and a resilient 2027 outlook, though higher energy costs are lifting inflation. OCBC expects a 25-basis-point hike to 3% at the 21 January 2027 meeting.

items.title: Wall Street AI rout sends Bursa down 1.17% on Friday
items.text: US stocks had their worst day in 18 months on Thursday, with the Nasdaq down 5.5% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index off more than 12%, dragging regional markets lower. The KLCI fell 19.28 points to 1,616.58 on Friday, erasing almost all of Thursday's gain; tech stocks were down as much as 5.78%, led by UWC, Vitrox, Pentamaster and Inari.

items.title: SunCon wins RM920.8m of extra MEP works for a Johor data centre
items.text: Sunway Construction secured additional mechanical, electrical and plumbing works for a data centre in Johor worth RM920.8 million, due for completion by the first quarter of 2028.

items.title: GDB lands RM877m Shah Alam logistics hub job; order book at RM2.93b
items.text: GDB Holdings won a contract to demolish a factory and build a two-block, five-storey logistics hub in Section 15, Shah Alam, due by September 2029. With an earlier RM1.02 billion ParkCity job, its outstanding order book rises to RM2.93 billion.

items.title: Tenaga and IOI Corp team up on a 500MW solar project in Bahau
items.text: Tenaga's TNB Renewables (70%), an IOI Corp unit (25%) and a consortium of 12 SMEs (5%) will develop a 500MW solar project with 250MW/1,000MWh of battery storage in Bahau, Negeri Sembilan, with maximum combined equity of RM606.2 million.

items.title: IOIPG plans Singapore private property fund; 50% stake sale could raise nearly RM10b
items.text: IOI Properties plans a private real estate fund backed by S$6 billion (RM19.1 billion) of Singapore assets; selling a 50% stake could raise close to RM10 billion. It targets a secondary listing on the Singapore Exchange in early 2027 and aims to cut net gearing from about 85% to 30%–50% over three to five years.

items.title: Paramount and Mitsui Fudosan partner on RM1.34b serviced apartment project
items.text: Paramount Corp (51%) and Japan's Mitsui Fudosan (49%) will jointly develop The Ashbourne, a 458-unit serviced apartment project worth RM1.34 billion, with construction from the fourth quarter of 2026 and completion by end-2030.

items.title: Sapura Industrial wins about RM307m Chery axle deal; Binastra lands RM303.8m automated warehouse job
items.text: Sapura Industrial signed an axle assembly contract with Chery worth about RM307 million over 4.5 years, its first direct deal with the carmaker. Binastra won a RM303.8 million automated warehouse contract from PTT Synergy, with works running from 11 November 2026 to 30 September 2027.

items.title: Public Bank sets up RM20b Islamic medium-term note programme
items.text: Public Bank established a RM20 billion Islamic medium-term note programme with a 30-year tenure, with preliminary ratings from RAM of AAA for senior and AA1 for subordinated notes.

days.title: 马股挫1.17%收1,616.58点；华尔街 AI 科技股重挫，区域股市全线走低

market.note: 美股隔夜大跌拖累区域市场，马股全天受压，跌股远多于涨股；金融服务、种植和能源指数齐跌，马银行、大众银行、国能及联昌国际等权值股走低。分析员认为，这波跌势主要源自外围不确定因素，而非国内基本面转弱。

items.title: 华尔街 AI 科技股重挫，马股科技股早盘跌近6%
items.text: 美股周四录得18个月来最差表现，纳指挫5.5%、标普500跌4.36%、道指跌3.44%，费城半导体指数跌逾12%。马股科技股今早一度跌5.78%，UWC、Vitrox、Pentamaster 和 Inari 等跌幅居前。

items.title: 韩股暴跌逾8%触发熔断，三星与 SK 海力士重挫
items.text: 韩国综合指数开盘跌逾8%，9个月来首次跌破5,000点，交易所启动20分钟熔断机制。三星电子跌10%、SK 海力士跌13%；美国中期选举后，市场对 AI 与数据中心政策的不确定性升温，拖累芯片股。

items.title: 国行维持隔夜政策利率于2.75%
items.text: 国家银行在今年最后一次货币政策会议上维持隔夜政策利率（OPR）于2.75%，指第三季经济增长稳健，预计2027年保持韧性，但能源成本走高推升通胀。华侨银行预计国行或在2027年1月21日的会议上升息25个基点至3%。

items.title: 周四马股大涨19.30点，成交额增至 RM3.61 billion
items.text: 国行议息结果出炉前后，马股周四收涨19.30点或1.19%至1,635.86点，成交量37.4亿股、值 RM3.61 billion，高于前一天的28.1亿股和 RM2.57 billion；但周五随外围急挫，涨幅几乎全数回吐。

items.title: KEB 公众部分认购1.01倍，11月16日上 ACE
items.text: KEB 的 IPO 大马公众部分共接获2,126份申请，认购4,447万股，略高于可供认购的4,412万股，其中土著部分申请2,731万股、其他公众1,716万股。KEB 将于11月16日在 ACE Market 挂牌。

items.title: 印尼 Danantara 拟对煤炭、棕油出口收服务费
items.text: 印尼主权基金 Danantara 旗下商品贸易单位计划向煤炭、棕油和铁合金出口收取服务费，费率仍在计算中。当地出口商担心收费过高会侵蚀利润、削弱价格竞争力，促请尽早公布收费结构。

en.title: KLCI falls 1.17% to 1,616.58 as a Wall Street AI tech rout drags regional markets lower
en.note: Bursa stayed under pressure all day after Wall Street's overnight slump, with losers far outnumbering gainers. The financial services, plantation and energy indices all fell, and heavyweights Maybank, Public Bank, Tenaga and CIMB declined. An analyst said the weakness reflected external uncertainty rather than weaker domestic fundamentals.

items.title: Wall Street AI tech rout; Bursa tech stocks fall nearly 6% in early trade
items.text: US stocks had their worst session in 18 months on Thursday: the Nasdaq fell 5.5%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped more than 12%. Malaysian tech stocks were down 5.78% this morning, led by UWC, Vitrox, Pentamaster and Inari.

items.title: Kospi plunges over 8%, triggering a circuit breaker; Samsung and SK Hynix slump
items.text: South Korea's Kospi fell more than 8% at the open, dropping below 5,000 for the first time in nine months, and the exchange halted trading for 20 minutes. Samsung Electronics fell 10% and SK Hynix 13%, as uncertainty over AI and data-centre policy after the US midterm elections hit chip stocks.

items.title: Bank Negara keeps the OPR at 2.75%
items.text: At its final Monetary Policy Committee meeting of 2026, Bank Negara held the overnight policy rate at 2.75%, citing solid third-quarter growth and a resilient 2027 outlook, while higher energy costs have pushed up inflation. OCBC expects a 25-basis-point hike to 3% at the 21 January 2027 meeting.

items.title: KLCI jumped 19.30 points on Thursday as turnover rose to RM3.61 billion
items.text: Around Bank Negara's rate decision, the KLCI closed 19.30 points or 1.19% higher at 1,635.86 on Thursday, on volume of 3.74 billion shares worth RM3.61 billion, up from 2.81 billion shares and RM2.57 billion the day before. Friday's sell-off erased almost all of the gain.

items.title: KEB's public portion 1.01 times subscribed; ACE Market listing on 16 Nov
items.text: KEB's IPO drew 2,126 applications from the Malaysian public for 44.47 million shares, slightly above the 44.12 million available: 27.31 million from the Bumiputera portion and 17.16 million from other Malaysians. KEB lists on the ACE Market on 16 November.

items.title: Indonesia's Danantara plans export service fees on coal and palm oil
items.text: The commodity trading arm of Indonesia's sovereign fund Danantara plans to charge service fees on exports of coal, palm oil and ferroalloys, with rates still being calculated. Indonesian exporters warned that high fees could erode margins and price competitiveness and asked for the fee structure to be disclosed soon.

days.title: 马股收涨0.14%报1,621.85点；TNB 联手 IOI Corp 投资 RM606m 发展500MW太阳能

market.note: 区域半导体股遭抛售，投资者对 AI 巨额投资的回报存疑，大马指数靠银行股守住小涨：兴业银行与大马银行各升21仙，丰隆银行升16仙。市场气氛谨慎，跌股仍多于涨股，马太平洋工业与 Kelington 等科技股走低。

items.title: TNB 联手 IOI Corp 与中小企，在马口建500MW太阳能
items.text: 国能旗下 TNB Renewables（持股70%）、IOI Corp 子公司（25%）及12家中小企组成的财团（5%）成立合资公司，在森美兰马口（Bahau）发展500MW太阳能项目，配备250MW/1,000MWh电池储能，属企业再生能源供应计划（CRESS）。三方最高股本投入合共 RM606.2 million，其中国能最多 RM424.4 million；国能预料对本财年业绩无重大影响。

items.title: GDB 获 RM877m 莎阿南物流中心工程
items.text: GDB Holdings 子公司接获 Rochester Logistics Asset 2 的工程，拆除旧厂并兴建两栋五层物流中心，工期34个月，11月4日动工，目标2029年9月3日完工。连同早前 RM1.02 billion 的 ParkCity Residence 合约，手头订单增至 RM2.93 billion。

items.title: MM Computer Systems 获 RM51.58m AI 服务器订单
items.text: MM Computer Systems（MMCS）旗下 Micro Technology Solution 获大马一家电讯基建及数据中心服务商颁发合约，供应 GPU 加速服务器，总值 RM51.58 million。客户名称未披露。

items.title: Theta Edge 子公司获 RM33m 电脑供应合约
items.text: Theta Edge 旗下 Theta Technologies 获 Aceteam Networks 委任为设备即服务（DaaS）项目的独家供应商，供应最多5,742台手提及桌上电脑，合约值 RM33.01 million，为期60个月。公司预料从截至2027年12月31日的财年起贡献盈利。

items.title: HB Global 财务总监辞职，年报未交或11月10日停牌
items.text: HB Global 委任拿督 Ng Chee Siong 为执行董事，财务总监11月2日辞职，创办人兼首席执行员10月30日卸任。审计师退出后公司仍在物色新审计师；若11月6日前未能发布年报，股票将从11月10日起暂停交易。

items.title: MyDCD 申购已截止，11月17日上 ACE 市场
items.text: 数据中心机电工程服务商 MyDCD 的 IPO 申购已于11月2日下午5时截止，每股56仙，发行3.35亿新股筹资 RM187.6 million，另献售1.45亿旧股，预计11月17日挂牌。

items.title: 国行11月5日议息，市场普遍预期 OPR 维持2.75%
items.text: 交易员称投资者正等待国家银行周四的利率决定，普遍预期隔夜政策利率维持在2.75%。令吉周二走软0.1%至兑1美元4.0755令吉。

items.title: 美股涨跌互见，芯片股撑起纳指；中期选举结果待揭晓
items.text: 美股周二常规交易收市，追踪标普500的 SPY 涨0.31%，追踪纳指100的 QQQ 涨0.62%，追踪道指的 DIA 跌0.44%。芯片股领涨，苹果因假期季度毛利率展望令人失望而下跌1.90%。部分投资者与分析师认为，若民主党横扫国会，或对周三股市构成压力。

items.title: AMD 第三季营收增45%，数据中心业务近翻倍
items.text: AMD 第三季营收134亿美元，按年增45%；数据中心业务营收85亿美元，增97%。公司预测第四季营收约170亿美元（上下3%）。AI 芯片需求动向是大马半导体股的关注点之一。

en.title: KLCI closes up 0.14% at 1,621.85; TNB and IOI Corp team up on RM606m, 500MW solar project
en.note: Banks kept the index slightly higher as a regional sell-off in chip stocks, driven by doubts over returns on heavy AI spending, weighed on sentiment: RHB Bank and AMMB each rose 21 sen and Hong Leong Bank 16 sen. Mood stayed cautious, with decliners outnumbering gainers and tech names such as Malaysian Pacific Industries and Kelington lower.

items.title: TNB, IOI Corp and SMEs to build 500MW solar project in Bahau
items.text: Tenaga's TNB Renewables (70%), an IOI Corp unit (25%) and a consortium of 12 SMEs (5%) will form a joint venture for a 500MW solar project in Bahau, Negeri Sembilan, with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery system, under the Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme. Maximum equity totals RM606.2 million, of which Tenaga commits up to RM424.4 million; Tenaga expects no material impact on this financial year.

items.title: GDB wins RM877m Shah Alam logistics hub job
items.text: A GDB Holdings unit accepted a job from Rochester Logistics Asset 2 to demolish a factory and build a two-block, five-storey logistics hub. Work runs 34 months from 4 November, with completion targeted for 3 September 2029. Together with the earlier RM1.02 billion ParkCity Residence job, the order book rises to RM2.93 billion.

items.title: MM Computer Systems secures RM51.58m AI server order
items.text: MM Computer Systems' unit Micro Technology Solution won a RM51.58 million contract to supply GPU-accelerated servers to a Malaysian telecommunications infrastructure and data centre services provider, which was not named.

items.title: Theta Edge unit wins RM33m computer supply contract
items.text: Theta Technologies, a Theta Edge subsidiary, was named exclusive supplier by Aceteam Networks for a Device as a Service project covering up to 5,742 laptops and desktops. The contract is worth RM33.01 million over 60 months and is expected to contribute to earnings from the year ending 31 December 2027.

items.title: HB Global's CFO resigns; trading may halt on 10 Nov over late annual report
items.text: HB Global named Datuk Ng Chee Siong as executive director; its CFO resigned on 2 November and its founder-CEO stepped down on 30 October. The company is seeking a new auditor after its previous one withdrew, and its shares will be suspended from 10 November if the annual report is not out by 6 November.

items.title: MyDCD applications closed; ACE Market listing set for 17 Nov
items.text: Applications for the IPO of data centre MEPF engineering firm MyDCD closed at 5pm on 2 November. The 56-sen offer comprises 335 million new shares raising RM187.6 million and 145 million existing shares for sale, with listing scheduled for 17 November.

items.title: Bank Negara decides on 5 Nov; OPR widely expected to stay at 2.75%
items.text: Dealers said investors are awaiting Thursday's rate decision, with the overnight policy rate widely expected to stay at 2.75%. The ringgit eased 0.1% to 4.0755 against the US dollar on Tuesday.

items.title: US stocks mixed as chips lift Nasdaq; midterm results awaited
items.text: In Tuesday's regular session SPY rose 0.31%, QQQ gained 0.62% and DIA fell 0.44%. Chip stocks led, while Apple dropped 1.90% after a disappointing holiday-quarter gross margin forecast. Some investors and analysts said a Democratic sweep of Congress could weigh on stocks on Wednesday.

items.title: AMD Q3 revenue up 45%, data centre sales nearly double
items.text: AMD reported third-quarter revenue of US$13.4 billion, up 45% from a year earlier, with data centre revenue of US$8.5 billion, up 97%. It guided fourth-quarter revenue of about US$17 billion, plus or minus 3%.

days.title: 马股微涨0.14%，银行股撑盘；IOI 旗下 REIT 定价96仙，11月25日上主板

market.note: 银行股走强带动指数小涨：马银行、联昌及大众银行皆起，兴业银行与大马银行涨21仙；国能与 IHH 则拖累指数。下跌股多于上涨股，大市情绪偏谨慎。

items.title: IOIPG Malaysia REIT 定价每单位96仙，筹资约 RM2.1 billion
items.text: IOI Properties 旗下的 IOIPG Malaysia REIT 发售最多22亿个单位，以每单位 RM0.96 计筹资约 RM2.1 billion，预计11月25日在主板挂牌。零售部分共约7.16亿单位，其中1.1亿单位开放给大马公众。这是大马至少13年来最大的 REIT 上市。

items.title: Advance Technologies Asia 签署包销协议，筹备上 ACE
items.text: 机电工程方案商 Advance Technologies Asia（ATA）将发行1.036亿新股（占扩大后股本22.82%），另献售1,740万旧股，其中2,270万股开放给大马公众，由 Malacca Securities 包销。公司正扩展数据中心运营与维护业务。

items.title: ISF Group 获4份数据中心合约共 RM83.2m
items.text: ISF Group 拿下波德申一座超大规模数据中心的4份合约，总值 RM83.2 million，未入账订单增至 RM225.5 million。

items.title: Econpile 获东禅医院 RM73m 打桩工程
items.text: Econpile 获颁吉隆坡东禅医院新大楼的打桩与地下结构工程，合约值 RM73 million，工期21个月。

items.title: Signature Alliance 获浮罗交怡海底世界翻新工程
items.text: Signature Alliance Group 获 RM51.56 million 合约，重建与翻新浮罗交怡海底世界，工程11月13日起为期18个月。

items.title: Northern Solar 获两项数据中心绿电供应
items.text: Northern Solar 在企业再生能源供应计划下获两项项目，为数据中心供应合共189MWac太阳能并配备储能。

items.title: Pekat 斥资 RM30.58m 购入汝来工业地
items.text: Pekat Group 以 RM30.58 million 收购汝来6块工业地，扩充开关设备、电池储能、变压器与变电站业务。

items.title: Dialog 扩建丹绒浪莎油库
items.text: Dialog 将在柔佛丹绒浪莎油库增加10万立方米储量，预计2029年中总储量突破110万立方米。

en.title: KLCI edges up 0.14% on banks; IOI's REIT priced at 96 sen, lists on Main Market on 25 Nov
en.note: Gains in banking stocks lifted the index: Maybank, CIMB and Public Bank rose, while RHB Bank and AMMB each added 21 sen; Tenaga and IHH weighed on the benchmark. Decliners outnumbered gainers, a sign of cautious sentiment.

items.title: IOIPG Malaysia REIT priced at RM0.96 a unit, raising about RM2.1 billion
items.text: IOI Properties' IOIPG Malaysia REIT is offering up to 2.2 billion units at RM0.96 each to raise about RM2.1 billion, with a Main Market listing expected on 25 November. The retail portion totals about 716 million units, including 110 million units for the Malaysian public. It is Malaysia's largest REIT listing in at least 13 years.

items.title: Advance Technologies Asia signs underwriting deal ahead of ACE listing
items.text: M&E engineering solutions provider Advance Technologies Asia (ATA) will issue 103.6 million new shares (22.82% of the enlarged share capital) and offer 17.4 million existing shares; 22.7 million shares go to the Malaysian public, underwritten by Malacca Securities. The company is expanding its data-centre operations and maintenance business.

items.title: ISF Group wins four data-centre contracts worth RM83.2m
items.text: ISF Group secured four contracts for a hyperscale data centre in Port Dickson worth a combined RM83.2 million, lifting its unbilled order book to RM225.5 million.

items.title: Econpile lands RM73m piling job for Tung Shin Hospital
items.text: Econpile won the piling and substructure works for a new Hospital Tung Shin building in Kuala Lumpur, worth RM73 million over 21 months.

items.title: Signature Alliance to refurbish Underwater World Langkawi
items.text: Signature Alliance Group secured a RM51.56 million contract to redevelop and refurbish Underwater World Langkawi, with 18 months of works starting 13 November.

items.title: Northern Solar wins two green-power supply awards for data centres
items.text: Northern Solar received two awards under the corporate renewable energy supply scheme to supply a combined 189MWac of solar power with battery storage to data centres.

items.title: Pekat buys Nilai industrial land for RM30.58m
items.text: Pekat Group is acquiring six industrial parcels in Nilai for RM30.58 million to expand its switchgear, battery storage, transformer and substation businesses.

items.title: Dialog expands Tanjung Langsat terminal
items.text: Dialog is adding 100,000 cubic metres of storage at its Tanjung Langsat terminal in Johor, taking total capacity above 1.1 million cubic metres by mid-2029.
